name: cudnn-frontend
description: cuDNN Frontend is NVIDIA's modern, open-source entry point to the cuDNN library and a growing collection of high-performance open-source kernels.

issues.title: Move License form MIT to Apache-2

latest_release.name: v1.32.3 release
latest_release.body:
- DSA backward: Improve deterministic dKV relay performance on SM100 and add relay cluster-size selection ([#2072](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/2072), [#2082](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/2082)).
- DSA backward: Add deterministic execution on SM90 with configurable relay cluster sizes ([#2209](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/2209)).
- DSA indexer: Add deterministic backward execution on SM90 and improve dW reduction for top-k values of 512 and above ([#2249](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/2249)).
- CSA compressor: Enable compression ratios 2 and 4 on SM90 and tune ratio-2 backward schedules ([#2247](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/2247)).
- PyTorch SDPA: Detect the cuDNN SDPA switch in `torch.nn.attention` to avoid duplicate provider registration ([#2368](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/2368)).
